Name: Nyapu Style Better Things Agatha
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Agatha- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/center][/size][/b]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

Merry Christmas everyone. I figured I would try to get several of my retextures done before the holiday season as one large drop, Agatha being one of them. I am glad I was able to make it in time. 

[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24397]Better Things[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. They did most of the heavy lifting for this retexture. I only did a few minor edits and added a winter outfit to one of their designs.

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59340891]Maatsuki[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.

[b]
[i][b]What am I working on?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/i]
